SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
Upper Endoscopy Report (fictional)
Date of service: October 28, 2026
Endoscopist: Tobias Wrenfield, MD (fictional)
Patient: Test Patient Calloway (fictional) | MRN: SYN-61177
Indications: Barrett esophagus surveillance; intermittent dysphagia.
Sedation: Monitored anesthesia care by the anesthesia service.
Procedure
The gastroscope was passed to the second portion of the duodenum. A salmon-colored segment of Barrett esophagus
extended from 32 to 35 cm. Four-quadrant biopsies were taken with cold forceps every 2 cm through the Barrett segment.
A guide wire was placed into the stomach under direct vision, the gastroscope was withdrawn, and Savary-Gilliard
dilators of 14, 15 and 16 mm were passed over the wire with moderate resistance at the gastroesophageal junction. The
gastroscope was reintroduced and showed mild mucosal disruption only. The stomach and duodenum were otherwise normal.
The stomach was decompressed and the endoscope was withdrawn.
Impression
Barrett esophagus, biopsied. Esophageal narrowing dilated over a guide wire to 16 mm.
Plan
Await pathology. Repeat endoscopy depending on histology.
Electronically signed by Tobias Wrenfield, MD (fictional), October 28, 2026
